parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    request,
    request->>'action' AS action,
    NULLIF(btrim(request->>'return_direction'), '') AS return_direction,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    END AS local_operator_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id')::uuid
    END AS book_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,l1a_unit_id}', request->>'l1a_unit_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,l1a_unit_id}', request->>'l1a_unit_id')::uuid
    END AS l1a_unit_id
  FROM input
), restart AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN n.action IN ('replan', 'restart') THEN public.rpc_finalize_deduction_snapshot(n.request)
    ELSE NULL::jsonb
  END AS replan_response
  FROM normalized AS n
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    r.replan_response,
    bp.title AS book_title,
    bp.current_l1a_id,
    bp.active_l1a_json,
    bp.token_budget,
    bp.token_budget_version,
    l.l1a_index,
    l.l1a_name,
    l.conflict_background,
    l.escalation_path,
    l.stakes,
    l.irreversible_consequence,
    l.plot_emotion_commit,
    l.arc_requirement,
    l.info_reveal_boundary,
    l.role_arc_json,
    l.participant_chars_json,
    l.world_resistance_refs,
    l.status AS l1a_status,
    l.confirmation_status AS l1a_confirmation_status,
    l.is_locked AS l1a_is_locked,
    l.is_formal AS l1a_is_formal
  FROM normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN restart AS r
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS bp
    ON bp.id = n.book_id
   AND bp.local_operator_id = n.local_operator_id
  LEFT JOIN public.l1a_unit AS l
    ON l.id = n.l1a_unit_id
   AND l.book_id = bp.id
   AND l.is_valid
   AND NOT l.is_shadow
), assembled AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    chapter_data.chapters,
    chapter_data.checkpoint_count,
    character_data.characters,
    world_data.world_state,
    relation_data.relations,
    binding_data.runtime_bindings,
    binding_data.model_bindings,
    binding_data.binding_count
  FROM scoped AS s
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'chapter_id', h.id,
        'chapter_version_id', cv.id,
        'predecessor_version_id', cv.predecessor_version_id,
        'chapter_index', h.chapter_index,
        'title', h.title,
        'status', h.status,
        'run_status', h.run_status,
        'target_snapshot_json', cv.target_snapshot_json,
        'chapter_implementation_json', cv.chapter_implementation_json,
        'scene_condition_package', COALESCE(
          cv.target_snapshot_json->'scene_condition_package',
          cv.chapter_implementation_json->'scene_condition_package'
        ),
        'particles_source', COALESCE(
          cv.target_snapshot_json->'particles_json',
          cv.target_snapshot_json->'particles',
          cv.chapter_implementation_json->'particles'
        ),
        'participants_source', s.participant_chars_json,
        'checkpoint', CASE
          WHEN cv.candidate_plot_sim_json IS NULL AND cv.deduction_progress_json IS NULL THEN NULL
          ELSE jsonb_build_object(
            'candidate_plot_sim_json', cv.candidate_plot_sim_json,
            'deduction_progress_json', cv.deduction_progress_json
          )
        END,
        'shadow_summary', COALESCE(cv.candidate_plot_sim_json #>> '{chapter_summary,summary}', ''),
        'deduction_locked', cv.deduction_locked
      )
      ORDER BY h.chapter_index
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS chapters,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE cv.candidate_plot_sim_json IS NOT NULL
        OR cv.deduction_progress_json IS NOT NULL
    )::integer AS checkpoint_count
    FROM public.chapter_header AS h
    JOIN public.chapter_version AS cv
      ON cv.chapter_id = h.id
     AND cv.book_id = h.book_id
     AND cv.version_state = 'candidate'
     AND cv.is_valid
     AND NOT cv.is_shadow
    WHERE h.book_id = s.book_id
      AND h.l1a_unit_id = s.l1a_unit_id
      AND NOT h.is_finalized
  ) AS chapter_data ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'character_id', c.id,
        'char_code', c.char_code,
        'char_name', c.char_name,
        'role_type', c.char_type,
        'five_layers_json', c.five_layers_json,
        'knowledge_boundary_json', c.knowledge_boundary_json,
        'arc_json', c.arc_json,
        'live_state_id', c.live_state_id,
        'live_state_source', CASE WHEN c.live_state_id IS NULL THEN 'initial_live_state_projection' ELSE 'formal_live_state' END,
        'live_state_json', CASE WHEN c.live_state_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'source', 'initial_live_state_projection',
          'five_layers_json', c.five_layers_json,
          'knowledge_boundary_json', c.knowledge_boundary_json
        ) ELSE jsonb_build_object(
          'philosophy_live_json', c.philosophy_live_json,
          'emotion_state_json', c.emotion_state_json,
          'drive_live_json', c.drive_live_json,
          'trigger_state_json', c.trigger_state_json,
          'goal_state_json', c.goal_state_json,
          'pressure_level', c.pressure_level,
          'current_goal_txt', c.current_goal_txt,
          'current_emo_tag', c.current_emo_tag
        ) END,
        'active_memory_json', COALESCE((
          SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'memory_id', m.id,
            'memory_type', m.memory_type,
            'memory_content', m.memory_content,
            'truth_status', m.truth_status,
            'is_valid', m.is_valid,
            'is_shadow', m.is_shadow,
            'importance', m.importance,
            'decay_rate', m.decay_rate
          ) ORDER BY m.importance DESC, m.created_at DESC, m.id)
          FROM public.character_memory AS m
          WHERE m.book_id = s.book_id
            AND m.char_id = c.id
            AND m.is_valid
            AND NOT m.is_shadow
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
      )
      ORDER BY COALESCE(c.char_code, c.char_name), c.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS characters
    FROM public.v_character_active AS c
    WHERE c.book_id = s.book_id
      AND c.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
      AND c.id IN (
        SELECT participant_id::uuid
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(s.participant_chars_json) AS participant_id
      )
  ) AS character_data ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'world_state_id', ws.id,
        'is_active', ws.is_active,
        'setting_layer', ws.setting_layer,
        'board_type', ws.board_type,
        'atom_type', ws.atom_type,
        'atom_key', ws.atom_key,
        'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb,
        'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims,
        'knowledge_boundary_json', ws.knowledge_boundary_json,
        'apply_scope_json', ws.apply_scope_json,
        'violate_cost_json', ws.violate_cost_json
      )
      ORDER BY ws.atom_key, ws.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS world_state
    FROM public.v_world_assets_for_exec AS ws
    WHERE ws.book_id = s.book_id
      AND ws.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
  ) AS world_data ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'relation_state_id', r.id,
        'char_a_id', r.char_a_id,
        'char_b_id', r.char_b_id,
        'trust', r.trust,
        'intimacy', r.intimacy,
        'power_balance', r.power_balance,
        'dependence', r.dependence,
        'hostility', r.hostility,
        'common_goal', r.common_goal,
        'secret_known', r.secret_known,
        'emotional_bond', r.emotional_bond,
        'relation_type', r.relation_type,
        'relation_hierarchy', r.relation_hierarchy,
        'relation_origin', r.relation_origin,
        'relation_overview', r.relation_overview,
        'change_event_json', r.change_event_json,
        'is_formal', r.is_formal,
        'is_valid', r.is_valid,
        'is_shadow', r.is_shadow
      )
      ORDER BY r.char_a_id, r.char_b_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS relations
    FROM public.relation_state AS r
    WHERE r.book_id = s.book_id
      AND r.is_formal
      AND r.is_valid
      AND NOT r.is_shadow
  ) AS relation_data ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(
        b.node_code,
        to_jsonb(b) - 'local_operator_id'
        ORDER BY b.node_code
      ), '{}'::jsonb) AS runtime_bindings,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
          'NODE_05', jsonb_set(
            to_jsonb(r) - 'local_operator_id',
            '{node_code}', to_jsonb('NODE_05'::text)
          ) || jsonb_build_object('source_node_code', r.node_code),
          'NODE_06', jsonb_set(
            to_jsonb(r) - 'local_operator_id',
            '{node_code}', to_jsonb('NODE_06'::text)
          ) || jsonb_build_object('source_node_code', r.node_code)
        )
        FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS r
        WHERE r.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
          AND r.node_code = 'FP008-02'
          AND r.prompt_status = 'active'
          AND NULLIF(btrim(r.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(btrim(r.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(btrim(r.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(btrim(r.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
        LIMIT 1
      ), '{}'::jsonb) AS model_bindings,
      count(*)::integer AS binding_count
    FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
    WHERE b.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
      AND b.node_code IN ('FP008-01', 'FP008-02', 'FP008-03')
      AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS binding_data ON true
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'request', a.request,
  'scope_ok',
    a.action IN ('start', 'resume', 'restart', 'replan')
    AND a.local_operator_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.book_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.l1a_unit_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.current_l1a_id = a.l1a_unit_id
    AND a.l1a_status = 'locked_for_deduction'
    AND a.l1a_confirmation_status = 'creator_confirmed'
    AND a.l1a_is_locked
    AND a.l1a_is_formal
    AND ((a.action = 'start' AND a.return_direction IS NULL AND a.checkpoint_count = 0
      OR (a.action = 'restart' AND a.return_direction IS NULL
          AND COALESCE(a.replan_response->>'ok', 'false') = 'true'
          AND a.checkpoint_count = 0)
      OR (a.action = 'resume' AND a.return_direction IS NULL AND a.checkpoint_count > 0)
      OR (a.action = 'replan' AND a.return_direction IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(a.replan_response->>'ok', 'false') = 'true'
          AND a.checkpoint_count = 0)))
    AND a.token_budget = 10000000
    AND a.token_budget_version = 'mvp-fixed-10000000'
    AND jsonb_array_length(a.chapters) > 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.chapters) AS chapter(value)
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
        OR NOT (chapter.value->'scene_condition_package' ?& ARRAY[
          'scene_location', 'participant_chars', 'rule_locks', 'scene_affordance',
          'available_resource_codes', 'info_reveal_candidates', 'chain_reaction_candidates',
          'scene_constraints', 'forbid_lines_active', 'materialize_notes'
        ])
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'participant_chars') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'rule_locks') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'scene_affordance') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'available_resource_codes') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'info_reveal_candidates') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'chain_reaction_candidates') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'scene_constraints') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'forbid_lines_active') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'materialize_notes') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    )
    AND a.binding_count = 3
    AND a.runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP008-01', 'FP008-02', 'FP008-03']
    AND a.model_bindings ?& ARRAY['NODE_05', 'NODE_06'],
  'redacted_error', CASE
    WHEN a.action IS NULL
      OR a.action NOT IN ('start', 'resume', 'restart', 'replan')
      OR a.local_operator_id IS NULL
      OR a.book_id IS NULL
      OR a.l1a_unit_id IS NULL
      OR (a.action = 'replan' AND a.return_direction IS NULL)
      OR (a.action <> 'replan' AND a.return_direction IS NOT NULL)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'INVALID_REQUEST', 'message', 'The deduction command could not be accepted.')
    WHEN a.action IN ('replan', 'restart')
      AND COALESCE(a.replan_response->>'ok', 'false') <> 'true'
      THEN jsonb_build_object(
        'code', COALESCE(a.replan_response#>>'{error,code}', CASE WHEN a.action = 'restart' THEN 'DEDUCTION_RESTART_REJECTED' ELSE 'DEDUCTION_REPLAN_REJECTED' END),
        'message', COALESCE(a.replan_response#>>'{error,message}', CASE WHEN a.action = 'restart' THEN 'The deduction restart could not be accepted.' ELSE 'The deduction replan could not be accepted.' END)
      )
    WHEN a.current_l1a_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.l1a_unit_id
      OR a.l1a_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'locked_for_deduction'
      OR a.l1a_confirmation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'creator_confirmed'
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.l1a_is_locked, false)
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.l1a_is_formal, false)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'L1A_SCOPE_REJECTED', 'message', 'The selected L1A is unavailable for deduction.')
    WHEN NOT ((a.action = 'start' AND a.return_direction IS NULL AND a.checkpoint_count = 0)
      OR (a.action = 'restart' AND a.return_direction IS NULL
          AND COALESCE(a.replan_response->>'ok', 'false') = 'true'
          AND a.checkpoint_count = 0)
      OR (a.action = 'resume' AND a.return_direction IS NULL AND a.checkpoint_count > 0)
      OR (a.action = 'replan' AND a.return_direction IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(a.replan_response->>'ok', 'false') = 'true'
          AND a.checkpoint_count = 0))
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'CHECKPOINT_ACTION_MISMATCH', 'message', 'Start, restart, and resume must match the persisted L1A checkpoint state.')
    WHEN a.token_budget IS DISTINCT FROM 10000000
      OR a.token_budget_version IS DISTINCT FROM 'mvp-fixed-10000000'
      OR a.binding_count IS DISTINCT FROM 3
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP008-01', 'FP008-02', 'FP008-03'], false)
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.model_bindings ?& ARRAY['NODE_05', 'NODE_06'], false)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED', 'message', 'The deduction runtime configuration is incomplete.')
    WHEN jsonb_array_length(a.chapters) = 0
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'CHAPTER_SCOPE_REJECTED', 'message', 'The selected L1A has no candidate chapters to deduce.')
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  'scope', jsonb_build_object(
    'local_operator_id', a.local_operator_id,
    'book_id', a.book_id,
    'l1a_unit_id', a.l1a_unit_id
  ),
  'token_budget', a.token_budget,
  'token_budget_version', a.token_budget_version,
  'l1a', jsonb_build_object(
    'l1a_unit_id', a.l1a_unit_id,
    'l1a_index', a.l1a_index,
    'l1a_name', a.l1a_name,
    'conflict_background', a.conflict_background,
    'escalation_path', a.escalation_path,
    'stakes', a.stakes,
    'irreversible_consequence', a.irreversible_consequence,
    'plot_emotion_commit', a.plot_emotion_commit,
    'arc_requirement', a.arc_requirement,
    'info_reveal_boundary', a.info_reveal_boundary,
    'role_arc_json', a.role_arc_json,
    'participant_chars_json', a.participant_chars_json,
    'world_resistance_refs', a.world_resistance_refs
  ),
  'chapters', a.chapters,
  'characters', a.characters,
  'world_state', a.world_state,
  'relations', a.relations,
  'runtime_bindings', a.runtime_bindings,
  'model_bindings', a.model_bindings
) AS context
FROM assembled AS a
WHERE a.action IN ('start', 'resume', 'restart', 'replan');

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    request,
    request->>'action' AS action,
    NULLIF(btrim(request->>'return_direction'), '') AS return_direction,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    END AS local_operator_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id')::uuid
    END AS book_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,l1a_unit_id}', request->>'l1a_unit_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,l1a_unit_id}', request->>'l1a_unit_id')::uuid
    END AS l1a_unit_id
  FROM input
), replan AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN n.action = 'replan' THEN public.rpc_finalize_deduction_snapshot(n.request)
    ELSE NULL::jsonb
  END AS response
  FROM normalized AS n
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    r.response AS replan_response,
    bp.title AS book_title,
    bp.current_l1a_id,
    bp.active_l1a_json,
    bp.token_budget,
    bp.token_budget_version,
    l.l1a_index,
    l.l1a_name,
    l.conflict_background,
    l.escalation_path,
    l.stakes,
    l.irreversible_consequence,
    l.plot_emotion_commit,
    l.arc_requirement,
    l.info_reveal_boundary,
    l.role_arc_json,
    l.participant_chars_json,
    l.world_resistance_refs,
    l.status AS l1a_status,
    l.confirmation_status AS l1a_confirmation_status,
    l.is_locked AS l1a_is_locked,
    l.is_formal AS l1a_is_formal
  FROM normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN replan AS r
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS bp
    ON bp.id = n.book_id
   AND bp.local_operator_id = n.local_operator_id
  LEFT JOIN public.l1a_unit AS l
    ON l.id = n.l1a_unit_id
   AND l.book_id = bp.id
   AND l.is_valid
   AND NOT l.is_shadow
), assembled AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    chapter_data.chapters,
    chapter_data.checkpoint_count,
    character_data.characters,
    world_data.world_state,
    relation_data.relations,
    binding_data.runtime_bindings,
    binding_data.model_bindings,
    binding_data.binding_count
  FROM scoped AS s
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'chapter_id', h.id,
        'chapter_version_id', cv.id,
        'predecessor_version_id', cv.predecessor_version_id,
        'chapter_index', h.chapter_index,
        'title', h.title,
        'status', h.status,
        'run_status', h.run_status,
        'target_snapshot_json', cv.target_snapshot_json,
        'chapter_implementation_json', cv.chapter_implementation_json,
        'scene_condition_package', COALESCE(
          cv.target_snapshot_json->'scene_condition_package',
          cv.chapter_implementation_json->'scene_condition_package'
        ),
        'particles_source', COALESCE(
          cv.target_snapshot_json->'particles_json',
          cv.target_snapshot_json->'particles',
          cv.chapter_implementation_json->'particles'
        ),
        'participants_source', s.participant_chars_json,
        'checkpoint', CASE
          WHEN cv.candidate_plot_sim_json IS NULL AND cv.deduction_progress_json IS NULL THEN NULL
          ELSE jsonb_build_object(
            'candidate_plot_sim_json', cv.candidate_plot_sim_json,
            'deduction_progress_json', cv.deduction_progress_json
          )
        END,
        'shadow_summary', COALESCE(cv.candidate_plot_sim_json #>> '{chapter_summary,summary}', ''),
        'deduction_locked', cv.deduction_locked
      )
      ORDER BY h.chapter_index
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS chapters,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE cv.candidate_plot_sim_json IS NOT NULL
        OR cv.deduction_progress_json IS NOT NULL
    )::integer AS checkpoint_count
    FROM public.chapter_header AS h
    JOIN public.chapter_version AS cv
      ON cv.chapter_id = h.id
     AND cv.book_id = h.book_id
     AND cv.version_state = 'candidate'
     AND cv.is_valid
     AND NOT cv.is_shadow
    WHERE h.book_id = s.book_id
      AND h.l1a_unit_id = s.l1a_unit_id
      AND NOT h.is_finalized
  ) AS chapter_data ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'character_id', c.id,
        'char_code', c.char_code,
        'char_name', c.char_name,
        'role_type', c.char_type,
        'five_layers_json', c.five_layers_json,
        'knowledge_boundary_json', c.knowledge_boundary_json,
        'arc_json', c.arc_json,
        'live_state_id', c.live_state_id,
        'live_state_source', CASE WHEN c.live_state_id IS NULL THEN 'initial_live_state_projection' ELSE 'formal_live_state' END,
        'live_state_json', CASE WHEN c.live_state_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'source', 'initial_live_state_projection',
          'five_layers_json', c.five_layers_json,
          'knowledge_boundary_json', c.knowledge_boundary_json
        ) ELSE jsonb_build_object(
          'philosophy_live_json', c.philosophy_live_json,
          'emotion_state_json', c.emotion_state_json,
          'drive_live_json', c.drive_live_json,
          'trigger_state_json', c.trigger_state_json,
          'goal_state_json', c.goal_state_json,
          'pressure_level', c.pressure_level,
          'current_goal_txt', c.current_goal_txt,
          'current_emo_tag', c.current_emo_tag
        ) END,
        'active_memory_json', COALESCE((
          SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'memory_id', m.id,
            'memory_type', m.memory_type,
            'memory_content', m.memory_content,
            'truth_status', m.truth_status,
            'is_valid', m.is_valid,
            'is_shadow', m.is_shadow,
            'importance', m.importance,
            'decay_rate', m.decay_rate
          ) ORDER BY m.importance DESC, m.created_at DESC, m.id)
          FROM public.character_memory AS m
          WHERE m.book_id = s.book_id
            AND m.char_id = c.id
            AND m.is_valid
            AND NOT m.is_shadow
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
      )
      ORDER BY COALESCE(c.char_code, c.char_name), c.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS characters
    FROM public.v_character_active AS c
    WHERE c.book_id = s.book_id
      AND c.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
      AND c.id IN (
        SELECT participant_id::uuid
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(s.participant_chars_json) AS participant_id
      )
  ) AS character_data ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'world_state_id', ws.id,
        'is_active', ws.is_active,
        'setting_layer', ws.setting_layer,
        'board_type', ws.board_type,
        'atom_type', ws.atom_type,
        'atom_key', ws.atom_key,
        'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb,
        'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims,
        'knowledge_boundary_json', ws.knowledge_boundary_json,
        'apply_scope_json', ws.apply_scope_json,
        'violate_cost_json', ws.violate_cost_json
      )
      ORDER BY ws.atom_key, ws.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS world_state
    FROM public.v_world_assets_for_exec AS ws
    WHERE ws.book_id = s.book_id
      AND ws.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
  ) AS world_data ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'relation_state_id', r.id,
        'char_a_id', r.char_a_id,
        'char_b_id', r.char_b_id,
        'trust', r.trust,
        'intimacy', r.intimacy,
        'power_balance', r.power_balance,
        'dependence', r.dependence,
        'hostility', r.hostility,
        'common_goal', r.common_goal,
        'secret_known', r.secret_known,
        'emotional_bond', r.emotional_bond,
        'relation_type', r.relation_type,
        'relation_hierarchy', r.relation_hierarchy,
        'relation_origin', r.relation_origin,
        'relation_overview', r.relation_overview,
        'change_event_json', r.change_event_json,
        'is_formal', r.is_formal,
        'is_valid', r.is_valid,
        'is_shadow', r.is_shadow
      )
      ORDER BY r.char_a_id, r.char_b_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS relations
    FROM public.relation_state AS r
    WHERE r.book_id = s.book_id
      AND r.is_formal
      AND r.is_valid
      AND NOT r.is_shadow
  ) AS relation_data ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(
        b.node_code,
        to_jsonb(b) - 'local_operator_id'
        ORDER BY b.node_code
      ), '{}'::jsonb) AS runtime_bindings,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
          'NODE_05', jsonb_set(
            to_jsonb(r) - 'local_operator_id',
            '{node_code}', to_jsonb('NODE_05'::text)
          ) || jsonb_build_object('source_node_code', r.node_code),
          'NODE_06', jsonb_set(
            to_jsonb(r) - 'local_operator_id',
            '{node_code}', to_jsonb('NODE_06'::text)
          ) || jsonb_build_object('source_node_code', r.node_code)
        )
        FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS r
        WHERE r.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
          AND r.node_code = 'FP008-02'
          AND r.prompt_status = 'active'
          AND NULLIF(btrim(r.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(btrim(r.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(btrim(r.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(btrim(r.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
        LIMIT 1
      ), '{}'::jsonb) AS model_bindings,
      count(*)::integer AS binding_count
    FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
    WHERE b.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
      AND b.node_code IN ('FP008-01', 'FP008-02', 'FP008-03')
      AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS binding_data ON true
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'request', a.request,
  'scope_ok',
    a.action IN ('start', 'resume', 'restart', 'replan')
    AND a.local_operator_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.book_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.l1a_unit_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.current_l1a_id = a.l1a_unit_id
    AND a.l1a_status = 'locked_for_deduction'
    AND a.l1a_confirmation_status = 'creator_confirmed'
    AND a.l1a_is_locked
    AND a.l1a_is_formal
    AND ((a.action IN ('start', 'restart') AND a.return_direction IS NULL AND a.checkpoint_count = 0)
      OR (a.action = 'resume' AND a.return_direction IS NULL AND a.checkpoint_count > 0)
      OR (a.action = 'replan' AND a.return_direction IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(a.replan_response->>'ok', 'false') = 'true'
          AND a.checkpoint_count = 0))
    AND a.token_budget = 10000000
    AND a.token_budget_version = 'mvp-fixed-10000000'
    AND jsonb_array_length(a.chapters) > 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.chapters) AS chapter(value)
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
        OR NOT (chapter.value->'scene_condition_package' ?& ARRAY[
          'scene_location', 'participant_chars', 'rule_locks', 'scene_affordance',
          'available_resource_codes', 'info_reveal_candidates', 'chain_reaction_candidates',
          'scene_constraints', 'forbid_lines_active', 'materialize_notes'
        ])
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'participant_chars') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'rule_locks') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'scene_affordance') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'available_resource_codes') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'info_reveal_candidates') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'chain_reaction_candidates') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'scene_constraints') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'forbid_lines_active') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_typeof(chapter.value->'scene_condition_package'->'materialize_notes') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    )
    AND a.binding_count = 3
    AND a.runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP008-01', 'FP008-02', 'FP008-03']
    AND a.model_bindings ?& ARRAY['NODE_05', 'NODE_06'],
  'redacted_error', CASE
    WHEN a.action IS NULL
      OR a.action NOT IN ('start', 'resume', 'restart', 'replan')
      OR a.local_operator_id IS NULL
      OR a.book_id IS NULL
      OR a.l1a_unit_id IS NULL
      OR (a.action = 'replan' AND a.return_direction IS NULL)
      OR (a.action <> 'replan' AND a.return_direction IS NOT NULL)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'INVALID_REQUEST', 'message', 'The deduction command could not be accepted.')
    WHEN a.action = 'replan'
      AND COALESCE(a.replan_response->>'ok', 'false') <> 'true'
      THEN jsonb_build_object(
        'code', COALESCE(a.replan_response#>>'{error,code}', 'DEDUCTION_REPLAN_REJECTED'),
        'message', COALESCE(a.replan_response#>>'{error,message}', 'The deduction replan could not be accepted.')
      )
    WHEN a.current_l1a_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.l1a_unit_id
      OR a.l1a_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'locked_for_deduction'
      OR a.l1a_confirmation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'creator_confirmed'
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.l1a_is_locked, false)
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.l1a_is_formal, false)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'L1A_SCOPE_REJECTED', 'message', 'The selected L1A is unavailable for deduction.')
    WHEN NOT ((a.action IN ('start', 'restart') AND a.return_direction IS NULL AND a.checkpoint_count = 0)
      OR (a.action = 'resume' AND a.return_direction IS NULL AND a.checkpoint_count > 0)
      OR (a.action = 'replan' AND a.return_direction IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(a.replan_response->>'ok', 'false') = 'true'
          AND a.checkpoint_count = 0))
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'CHECKPOINT_ACTION_MISMATCH', 'message', 'Start, restart, and resume must match the persisted L1A checkpoint state.')
    WHEN a.token_budget IS DISTINCT FROM 10000000
      OR a.token_budget_version IS DISTINCT FROM 'mvp-fixed-10000000'
      OR a.binding_count IS DISTINCT FROM 3
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP008-01', 'FP008-02', 'FP008-03'], false)
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.model_bindings ?& ARRAY['NODE_05', 'NODE_06'], false)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED', 'message', 'The deduction runtime configuration is incomplete.')
    WHEN jsonb_array_length(a.chapters) = 0
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'CHAPTER_SCOPE_REJECTED', 'message', 'The selected L1A has no candidate chapters to deduce.')
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  'scope', jsonb_build_object(
    'local_operator_id', a.local_operator_id,
    'book_id', a.book_id,
    'l1a_unit_id', a.l1a_unit_id
  ),
  'token_budget', a.token_budget,
  'token_budget_version', a.token_budget_version,
  'l1a', jsonb_build_object(
    'l1a_unit_id', a.l1a_unit_id,
    'l1a_index', a.l1a_index,
    'l1a_name', a.l1a_name,
    'conflict_background', a.conflict_background,
    'escalation_path', a.escalation_path,
    'stakes', a.stakes,
    'irreversible_consequence', a.irreversible_consequence,
    'plot_emotion_commit', a.plot_emotion_commit,
    'arc_requirement', a.arc_requirement,
    'info_reveal_boundary', a.info_reveal_boundary,
    'role_arc_json', a.role_arc_json,
    'participant_chars_json', a.participant_chars_json,
    'world_resistance_refs', a.world_resistance_refs
  ),
  'chapters', a.chapters,
  'characters', a.characters,
  'world_state', a.world_state,
  'relations', a.relations,
  'runtime_bindings', a.runtime_bindings,
  'model_bindings', a.model_bindings
) AS context
FROM assembled AS a
WHERE a.action IN ('start', 'resume', 'restart', 'replan');

        'message', 'The deduction flow did not produce a releasable result.'
      )
    )
  )
END AS response
FROM input;
